test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d712a8f0d8433df3a364ce32deca7b050889b23a57419bb6571a60fe774f4c3.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccb81837d115f44dadf9ec2c99ff329631adef591c7f48d4cbf238eb9036ea47.png] 

As 5 and 3 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 6 and 4 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bf8715bfc7a8c9037ac143ca212e9fc5f030e0529c2997629d629c4b79a9cbd.png] 

As 3 and 6 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 5 and 2 are opposite to each other.

As, 5 is opposite to 2, 6 is opposite to 4.

So, the remaining number '3' will be the number on the face opposite the face having '1'.

Hence, '**3**' is the correct answer.
